note: Borders: historical-basemaps by André Ourednik (GitHub aourednik/historical-basemaps, commit da7a4b7 of 15 Sep 2026, GPL-3.0). One map per century (500 BC, 400 BC … AD 1500); each is shown from its year until the next one. The project marks every border here as approximate (BORDERPRECISION 1) and asks users to check it against other sources. Orbis clipped the maps to Europe, North Africa and the Near East, simplified them (about 3% of points kept) and grouped polities by colour. This derived file is distributed under the GNU GPL v3, like its source.
